title: PSG4-SECOND-SCALE-SEVEN-BANK: counted basis storage for the q=1/3 two-scale program

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), L=log2n, the ONE PHYSICAL PSG4-SECOND-SCALE-SEVEN-BANK interpreter in proof.md executing the complete virtual program in virtual.md with unmodified family-source.md uses the explicit finite branch n<256 and otherwise ell_base=ceil(log2n), largest integer g_base^8*ell_base^3<=n^4 and g2_base^16*ell_base^7<=n^8, u=min(R,max(1,floor(7R/11)+max(0,floor(54g_base/77)-floor(193g2_base/484)))). Select the first feasible C4096 profile, recomputing all roots, decoder, precision and BOTH literal acquisition/weighted-work caps. Fixed parameters q=1/3,alpha=3/8,alpha2=7/16,eta=3/4. Full-secret unconditional success at least1-2^-8>2/3. Jointly on EVERY branch including failed/discarded work, wrong labels, both aborts, preparation and cleanup, paid time T is O(2^((11/12)sqrt(nL)+(3/4)sqrt(n)L^(-3/8)-(7/88)sqrt(n)L^(-7/16))) with exact index1/2. Every source, circuit generation, full address fee, arithmetic, extraction, measurement, reset, finite preprocessing, complete decoder and failed work is charged jointly with all four resources and clean fraction0 for this SAME configuration; all outside constants are absolute independent of N,s,outcomes. The entire seven-region padded basis bank and coherent slots, metadata, ownership/address arithmetic, measured READ/WRITE, one-for-one source SWAPs, initialization and cleanup are counted. All virtual large records live in counted qubits; physical classical input, output and fixed staged operands use O(n) bits, while the whole padded quantum allocation is O(n^2) qubits. Virtual memory columns are not substituted into this physical row.
